title: Generative Agent Simulations of 1,000 People
findings: The interview-based generative agents accurately predicted participants' responses to General Social Survey questions about religion (e.g., religious affiliation, prayer frequency, belief in an afterlife). The performance on these religious items was consistent with the overall high accuracy of the agents across all topics, which replicated participants' own answers with 85% of the accuracy that participants replicated their own answers two weeks later.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured attitudes, beliefs, and practices related to religion, using questions from the General Social Survey (GSS). Specific items included religious affiliation, frequency of prayer and attendance at services, and beliefs about God and the afterlife.
